requiredGates.evidence: Cargo.toml license=Apache-2.0, root LICENSE, and archive metadata/license smoke
Cargo package version exactly matches stable vX.Y.Z tag
successful main run bound to release commit
Linux READY retained compat/v2 report SHA-256 is required. macOS/Windows retained reports are optional Tier 2 evidence; canonical CI/package smoke remain required.
Linux real controlling-TTY PASS receipt is required. macOS/Windows terminal receipts are optional Tier 2 evidence.
cross-platform PTY lifecycle suite in canonical CI
Linux resident-planning-10k >= 200 iterations, p95 <= 50 ms and p99 <= 100 ms
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt generated from locked normal dependency closure
extracted Apache-2.0 LICENSE, release metadata, binary version and 10k headless fixture smoke pass on each platform
SHA256SUMS for all release bundle files

supportPolicy.policy: v1.0 stable requires real retained compatibility, terminal-restoration and performance evidence on Linux. macOS/Windows remain required in canonical CI and native package/archive smoke but do not block stable on real-environment retained evidence.
